description:
intent=i037 snapshot=s01 branch=stacks-outside-net-dirs status=complete
finding location=drivers/scsi/bnx2fc/bnx2fc_fcoe.c:526-568 confidence=medium conclusion=bnx2fc_recv_frame saves eth_hdr(skb)->h_dest/source into mac/dest_mac and reads them after pskb_trim(skb, fr_len), which can reallocate and free the old head for a cloned FCoE frame, yielding a stale-pointer slab UAF read (medium confidence).
finding location=drivers/infiniband/ulp/ipoib/ipoib_ib.c:575-654 confidence=medium conclusion=ipoib_send captures phead=skb->data for a GSO skb, then skb_linearize (line 598) can free the old head via pskb_expand_head for a cloned skb, and the stale phead is still passed to post_send/tx_wr.header and DMA-read by the HCA (medium confidence).
unresolved location=drivers/scsi/cxgbi/cxgb4i/cxgb4i.c:1282 conclusion=Read drivers/scsi/cxgbi/cxgb4i/cxgb4i.c around lines 1270-1300, 1380-1400 and 1540-1570 to check whether any header pointer survives the __pskb_trim calls and is dereferenced afterwards.
coverage_gap=drivers/tty modem-protocol code and drivers/staging networking drivers were enumerated by grep but only drivers/staging/octeon/ethernet-tx.c (a TX-only __skb_linearize with no captured pointer) was read; other staging drivers were not audited.
coverage_gap=The cxgbi/cxgb3i/cxgb4i, qedf, fnic and bnx2fc __pskb_trim/skb_linearize sites were pattern-triaged; only bnx2fc (reported) and fcoe (safe) were read to a conclusion, leaving cxgb4i unresolved and cxgb3i.c:828, qedf_main.c:2482-2503, fnic_fcs.c:310/562, fcoe_ctlr.c:1540 classified by pattern only.
coverage_gap=Non-linearity and cloning preconditions for the two reported findings were assessed structurally (eth_type_trans/GRO/tap cloning behavior) rather than by a runtime KASAN reproduction, since the snapshot is read-only and no build was attempted.
limitation=No build, KASAN run or reproducer was produced (read-only snapshot, no network): both findings are static-reading hypotheses, and the head reallocation in each is inferred from pskb_expand_head's alloc-copy-free of the old head and ___pskb_trim's skb_cloned() branch rather than observed.
limitation=The bnx2fc finding requires the received FCoE frame's skb to be cloned at pskb_trim time (e.g. by an AF_PACKET tap or GRO) and its length to exceed fr_len; on a never-cloned receive path the stale dest_mac still aliases valid memory and the issue is latent, hence medium not high confidence.
limitation=The ipoib finding is a TX-path variant: it needs a GSO skb with more frags than usable_sge that is also cloned when it reaches ipoib_send, and the stale read is performed by the HCA's DMA engine through tx_wr.header, so the observable failure is an I/O error or garbage header rather than a KASAN splat in softirq.
limitation=Branch target areas that turned out to have zero pull-family call sites in this snapshot (drivers/nfc, drivers/tty, drivers/isdn/hardware, most of drivers/staging) were cleared by grep only; a receive parser in them that reads multi-byte headers from skb->data without any pull at all (branch item c, no grep anchor) could not be exhaustively excluded.
limitation=Snapshot revision is opaque; line numbers and code state are valid only for snapshots/s01 as supplied, and net/phonet/pep.c pep_get_sb was deliberately never reported per the branch instruction.
